summary: Iteration 4 backend validation complete. Created /app/backend/tests/test_features_v3.py with 45 new tests covering math consistency on seeded data (order.subtotal=qty*price, gross=SUM(items), tax.amount=base*rate, net=gross-taxes), state-specific ICMS rates, accounts receivable, team ranking, company goal, fiscal regime toggle (classic/hybrid/reforma), reforma math (CBS+IBS), hybrid math (halved rates), marketplace sync + notifications, SPED block C + M export, CSV regression (BOM+semicolon+PT-BR headers), and WhatsApp lead inbox. All 45 new tests PASS. Regression: 203/203 previous tests still pass when run in the same suite as v3 EXCEPT for a race condition (see below).

minor.issue: FISCAL_MODE is stored in os.environ (process-global). If admin toggles regime while another request is emitting an invoice concurrently, the wrong regime is applied. This surfaced during parallel pytest-xdist runs where v3 toggle tests transiently switched to reforma/hybrid, causing 4 of v2's ICMS parametrized tests to fail with halved rates. In production this means any concurrent invoice emission during a regime switch will be tainted. Recommend: persist regime in a Config/Settings DB row and read fresh per-request instead of relying on env vars, OR use a request-scoped override header for testing.

Numeric column for rate is stored with scale 4. When rate = 0.00825 (hybrid PIS half) it rounds to 0.0083 in DB, causing base*rate_stored (=8.30) to differ from the persisted amount (=8.25) by ~R$0.05. Amount is correct; only the reverse-derivable check is off. Consider scale=6 for rate, or document that amount is source-of-truth.

action_items: Persist FISCAL_MODE in a DB Settings row (not os.environ) to make regime switching concurrency-safe. Currently the runtime toggle races with concurrent invoice emissions.
Widen InvoiceTax.rate column scale (4 -> 6) OR round rate to scale 4 at write time so base*rate == amount exactly. Not user-facing but breaks strict reverse math checks.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py math is correct end-to-end: subtotal=qty*price, gross=SUM(subtotals), taxes via calculate_taxes(gross, type, uf), commissions=amount*rate rounded to 2dp — verified across 20 seeded orders + 26 leads across all 6 statuses.
dashboard_router.set_fiscal_regime relies on os.environ writes — see minor concern above.

marketplace_router.sync_channel: notification creation happens INSIDE the loop for each stock alert with individual create_notification calls that all target admin.id — fine, but N+1 pattern. Consider batch insert if channels grow large.
reports_router.export_sped: closing record |9999| count uses len(lines)+1 which counts itself — matches SPED spec.
notifications_router.create_notification only flushes, relying on caller to commit. Documented behavior but risky if caller forgets.
